title: calystegia stans
intro: Calystegia stans, commonly known as Beach Morning Glory, is a perennial climbing plant native to the coastal regions of Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Calystegia stans include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relax muscles, reduce swelling, and ease coughs. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
